lines.text: Ella adds juice AND water to her drink.
lines.caption: Ella adds juice AND water to her drink.

lines.text: And it gets STRONGER! How much water?
lines.caption: And it gets STRONGER! How much water?

lines.text: A twenty-liter drink is thirty percent juice. She adds juice and water.
lines.caption: A twenty-liter drink is thirty percent juice. She adds juice and water.

lines.text: Now twenty-five liters, forty percent juice. How much water did she add?
lines.caption: Now twenty-five liters, forty percent juice. How much water did she add?

lines.text: Here's the trick. Split each drink into juice and water.
lines.caption: Here's the trick. Split each drink into juice and water.

lines.text: First drink: six juice, fourteen water. Last drink: ten juice, fifteen water.
lines.caption: First drink: six juice, fourteen water. Last drink: ten juice, fifteen water.

lines.text: Now watch the water: fourteen, then fifteen.
lines.caption: Now watch the water: fourteen, then fifteen.

lines.text: She added just ONE liter of water! That's Choice B.
lines.caption: She added just ONE liter of water! That's Choice B.

lines.text: Most kids say four. But that's the juice!
lines.caption: Most kids say four. But that's the juice!
